content.CONFIG.subtitle: Malija 143b, Izola
content.DATA.stay.title: Your stay
content.DATA.stay.items[0].label: Welcome
content.DATA.stay.items[0].body[1]: Thank you for choosing Meli Pu Apartments for your holiday. Our house stands on a sunny slope above Izola, surrounded by olive trees and cypresses, with a view that reaches all the way to the sea.
content.DATA.stay.items[0].body[2]: We wish you relaxed, warm and carefree days in our little corner of paradise. If you need anything at all, we are only a phone call away.
content.DATA.stay.items[1].label: Apartments
content.DATA.stay.items[1].items[0].name: Apartment 1
content.DATA.stay.items[1].items[0].desc: A bright apartment with a spacious terrace and a comfortable rattan seating corner. Ideal for a family or two couples.
content.DATA.stay.items[1].items[1].name: Apartment 2
content.DATA.stay.items[1].items[1].desc: A quiet apartment with a decorative chandelier and a bathroom in dark marble. Full of light all day long.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].label: Location
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[1]: You will find us at Malija 143b in Izola. Because Google Maps sometimes sends you the wrong way, we have written out the route ourselves — follow these directions and you cannot miss it.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[2]: Coming from Koper through the tunnel towards Izola, take the first exit for Izola. At the roundabout take the second exit, and about 50 metres later, at the next roundabout, the third exit.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[3]: Continue straight for about 500 metres to the next roundabout and again take the third exit (towards Korte, Šared). You will pass a Hofer store on your right.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[4]: At the small roundabout continue straight (second exit). Then follow about 3 km of climb past the village of Šared.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[5]: About 800 metres after Šared there is a sign for Malija — turn right. After another 500 metres a sign for Mala Seva appears on the right — turn there.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].body[6]: Drive about 800 metres more through a small settlement. We are the last house on the right.
content.DATA.stay.items[2].cta.label: Directions to us
content.DATA.stay.items[3].label: Parking
content.DATA.stay.items[3].body[0]: Parking is free for our guests, in the courtyard beside the house.
content.DATA.stay.items[3].body[1]: Please note that the owner accepts no responsibility for vehicles, for any damage to them, or for items left inside them.
content.DATA.stay.items[3].body[3]: A charging station for electric vehicles is also available. Please speak to your host before using it.
content.DATA.stay.items[4].label: Entrance gate
content.DATA.stay.items[4].body[0]: Press the left button on the remote — a light will come on and the gate will begin to open.
content.DATA.stay.items[4].body[1]: The gate stays open for 2 minutes, then closes by itself.
content.DATA.stay.items[4].body[2]: Please do not stop too close to the fence: there is a sensor there and the gate will not open.
content.DATA.stay.items[5].label: How things work
content.DATA.stay.items[5].tabs[0].body[0]: Please leave the water heater switched on throughout your stay. If you turn it off, you will be left without hot water.
content.DATA.stay.items[5].tabs[1].body[0]: Switch the TV on with the remote and the power button. For streaming, select input HDMI 1.
content.DATA.stay.items[5].tabs[1].body[1]: If there is no picture, check that the right source is selected on the remote.
content.DATA.stay.items[5].tabs[2].body[0]: Switch the air conditioning on with the remote. We recommend 24 °C.
content.DATA.stay.items[5].tabs[2].body[1]: When you leave the apartment, please turn it off and close the windows.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].label: Check-in / Check-out
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[0].list[0]: Your host needs your identity document at check-in. Only registered guests may stay in the apartment.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[0].list[1]: If you are expecting visitors, please let your host know in advance.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[0].list[2]: At check-in we go through the equipment and inventory together with the host.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[1].list[0]: Leave the keys at the agreed place or hand them to your host.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[1].list[1]: Please wash the dishes and take the rubbish to the bins by the driveway.
content.DATA.stay.items[6].tabs[1].list[2]: We check the equipment and inventory together.
content.DATA.stay.items[7].label: WiFi
content.DATA.stay.items[8].label: House rules
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[0].t: We are sorry, but pets are not allowed on the property.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[1].t: Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 07:00 — out of consideration for other guests and neighbours.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[2].t: Smoking inside the apartments is strictly prohibited.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[3].t: When you leave, close the doors and windows and switch off the water, the lights and all appliances.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[4].t: The owner is not liable for money, jewellery, securities or other valuables kept in the apartment or in a vehicle.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[5].t: In case of damage or a breakdown, please tell your host straight away.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[6].t: Please switch off lights and appliances you are not using — we save energy together.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[7].t: Please use hot water sparingly and do not put towels out for washing after a single use.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[8].t: Guests staying on the property must be 15 years or older.
content.DATA.stay.items[8].rules[9].t: Please clean the outdoor grill after use.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].label: Swimming pool
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[0].t: Glass in and around the pool is strictly prohibited. Please use the plastic glasses from the apartment.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[1].t: Use of the pool is at your own risk.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[2].t: Children under 18 only when accompanied by a parent.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[3].t: No jumping, diving, running, climbing on the edges, throwing objects or loud behaviour.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[5].t: Please take care of personal hygiene and keep the water clean.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[6].t: If you are not using the loungers, please take your towels and belongings with you.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[7].t: The pool and its surroundings are cleaned at night, so please do not leave anything on the loungers overnight.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[8].t: Breaking these rules may mean your stay is ended without a refund.
content.DATA.stay.items[9].rules[9].t: Any additional equipment must be agreed with the host in advance.
content.DATA.offer.title: What we offer
content.DATA.offer.items[0].label: SUP board
content.DATA.offer.items[0].products[0].name: SUP — daily rental
content.DATA.offer.items[0].products[0].desc: The board comes folded in a handy bag, ready to go. A hand pump is included, so you can inflate it in a few minutes anywhere, any time.
content.DATA.offer.items[1].label: Scooter
content.DATA.offer.items[1].warn: Riding the scooter is at your own risk.
content.DATA.offer.items[1].products[0].name: Scooter — 3 to 4 hours
content.DATA.offer.items[1].products[0].desc: Rent a scooter and explore at your own pace — quick, fun and made for a holiday adventure. Two helmets included.
content.DATA.offer.items[1].products[0].note: Fuel: you collect the scooter with a full tank and return it the same way, otherwise fuel is charged.
content.DATA.offer.items[2].label: Outdoor gym
content.DATA.offer.items[2].warn: Use of the outdoor gym is at your own risk.
content.DATA.offer.items[2].body[0]: The outdoor gym right next to the apartments is a simple way to stay active in the fresh air — with a punching bag, a pull-up bar, a bench and weights.
content.DATA.offer.items[2].body[1]: In the box beside the gym you will find weights, mats and smaller equipment. Please put everything back after use.
content.DATA.offer.items[3].label: Barbecue
content.DATA.offer.items[3].body[0]: The barbecue area is made for easy evenings and good company. A built-in grill station and a worktop let you cook outdoors, right beside the apartments.
content.DATA.offer.items[3].body[2]: Open the valve on the gas bottle before use.
content.DATA.offer.items[3].body[3]: After use, always close the gas and clean the grill.
content.DATA.offer.items[4].label: Boat with a skipper
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[0].name: Boat trip with a skipper — 3 hours
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[0].desc: Feel the freedom of a private cruise with your own skipper. Fun, relaxation and views of the Slovenian coast — for your group only.
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[0].note: Up to 4 people, each additional person +€20 (7 maximum). Boarding: Marina UP Izola; also possible in Koper, Piran, Portorož and Bernardin (+€40).
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[1].name: Boat trip with a skipper — 5 hours
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[1].desc: A longer version with more swimming stops and enough time to visit the coastal towns as well.
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[1].note: Up to 4 people, each additional person +€20 (7 maximum). Boarding: Marina UP Izola.
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[2].name: Trip by arrangement
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[2].desc: Tell us what you have in mind and the skipper will plan the trip around you.
content.DATA.offer.items[4].products[2].note: Up to 4 people, each additional person +€20 (7 maximum).
content.DATA.offer.items[5].label: Boat line
content.DATA.offer.items[5].intro:
The Zlatoperka — the coast from the sea
Step aboard a traditional fishing boat and see the Slovenian coast from the water. The line connects Ankaran, Koper, Izola and Piran — perfect for a lazy day on the Adriatic.
content.DATA.offer.items[5].products[0].name: Zlatoperka: Ankaran → Koper
content.DATA.offer.items[5].products[0].incl[0]: tickets are bought on board before departure
content.DATA.offer.items[5].products[1].name: Zlatoperka: Koper → Izola → Piran
content.DATA.offer.items[5].products[1].incl[0]: tickets are bought on board before departure
content.DATA.offer.items[6].label: Games
content.DATA.offer.items[6].body[0]: There is a selection of games for guests, for outdoors and for long afternoons in the shade: beach rackets, cards, board games (Ludo among them) and jigsaw puzzles.
content.DATA.offer.items[6].body[2]: They are kept to the right of the barbecue, in a box clearly marked „Igre“ (Games).
content.DATA.offer.items[7].label: Olive oil
content.DATA.offer.items[7].products[0].name: Homegrown organic olive oil
content.DATA.offer.items[7].products[0].desc: Extra virgin oil from our own olives — picked on the slopes above Izola and pressed the same day. A fine souvenir and an even better dinner.
content.DATA.offer.items[8].label: Ice cream 24/7
content.DATA.offer.items[8].body[1]: Our ice cream machine in Marina Izola runs 24 hours a day, every day of the week. Whenever the craving strikes, after dinner or after midnight — just come by.
